provenance.instrument: West Goshen Township Code Chapter 84 Zoning (adopted 12-13-1972, as amended), as published on eCode360
provenance.status_detail: eCode360 code date 2026-09-01 (breadcrumb). New Laws on 2026-11-14: none. The in-law suite section 84-57.25 was added 12-14-2016 by Ord. No. 5-2016.
provenance.code_current_through_note: eCode360 breadcrumb 'Code 2026-09-01'. New Laws: 'There are currently no known new laws for this Code.'
checks: An in-law suite is allowed by right (use and occupancy and zoning permit) only in the R-2, R-3 and R-4 districts: 'In-law suites shall only be permitted in the R-2, R-3 and R-4 Zoning Districts' (84-57.25B, 84-9D(6), 84-12D(6), 84-15D(6))
Only for a relative of the residents of the house (and the relative's spouse), at most two occupants. The Zoning Officer may ask for proof (84-8, 84-57.25B(1), (2))

The suite may not be more than 35% of the floor area of the house and the suite together (84-57.25B(5)). Floor area is the 84-8 definition: it includes basements that count as a story, attics with 8 ft headroom, porches more than 50% enclosed and accessory buildings, so it can be larger than the living area on a tax record
It may be in the house or 'in an existing accessory structure, such as a garage'. A new building for the suite is not named (84-57.25B(4))
The house must keep the look of a single-family house, and all utilities (gas, electric, heat, water, sewer) are shared (84-57.25B(6), (7))
The owner signs an agreement recorded with the Chester County Recorder of Deeds that bars renting the suite as an apartment to nonrelatives (84-57.25B(9))
Parking: two spaces for each dwelling unit (84-55J(2)(a)). Read as four for the house and the suite
The R-3A overlay, R-3B and R-3C use lists do not list in-law suites, and each allows the listed uses 'and no other' (84-14.1, 84-14.5, 84-14.8)

Storage sheds: side or rear yard only, not in front of the front facade, 6 ft from lot lines, at most 250 sq ft and 12 ft (84-57.21). A private garage must meet the district area and bulk rules (84-8)
In R-4 a semidetached or multifamily dwelling is a special exception on a development tract of at least three acres with public water and sewer (84-15E, 84-16C)
In C-1-R one single-family residence is allowed in the rear of or over a commercial establishment (84-35B)
provenance.notes: Zoning office: West Goshen Township (westgoshen.org). Read on eCode360 (WE0457) in a browser, one print view at a time, on 2026-11-14. Code searches for 'accessory dwelling', 'accessory apartment', 'in-law', ECHO, granny, 'family dwelling', caretaker and conversion found the in-law suite (84-8, 84-57.25 and the R-2, R-3 and R-4 lists), POP caretaker quarters (84-92) and country house estate rules (84-57.6). Use lists read for R-2, R-3, R-3A, R-3B, R-3C, R-4 and C-1-R. A 'Proposed West Goshen Township Zoning Ordinance' document is posted on the Township site (seen only as a search result title, not opened). It is not in New Laws.

term.note: 'A dwelling unit especially created for and limited to occupancy by a relative of the residents of the principal dwelling unit. Such unit may also house a spouse of such relative.'

status.note: Allowed by right as an accessory use in R-2, R-3 and R-4, only for a relative of the residents.

status_outside.note: 'In-law suites shall only be permitted in the R-2, R-3 and R-4 Zoning Districts.' Each district list allows the listed uses 'and no other'.

path.note: Listed among the accessory uses that 'shall be permitted'. A use and occupancy permit and a zoning permit are needed.

fallback_path.note: A suite that does not meet 84-57.25 needs a variance from the Zoning Hearing Board.

value.name: Semidetached dwelling on a development tract
value.conditions: Semidetached or multifamily dwellings by special exception: development tract of at least three acres, six units per acre at most, public water and public sewer, 50 ft setbacks, 2.5 parking spaces per unit.

building_types.note: The R-2, R-3 and R-4 lists allow the single-family detached dwelling, and the house 'must retain its appearance as a single-family dwelling'.

existing_structure_only.note: A suite inside or added to the house is not limited to existing space. A suite in an accessory building must use an existing one.

value.condition: 'An in-law suite shall be restricted for the occupancy and/or care of a relative as defined by § 84-8.' The Zoning Officer may require proof.
A suite outside the house must be in 'an existing accessory structure, such as a garage'.
The principal dwelling must keep its appearance as a single-family dwelling.
All utilities are shared, including gas, electric, heat, water and sewer.
A recorded agreement bars the owners and later owners from renting the suite as an apartment to nonrelatives.

types_allowed.note: In or added to the house, or in an existing accessory structure such as a garage. A new detached building is not named.

value.garage_conversion: In an existing accessory structure, such as a garage

max_sqft.note: No square-foot cap. The cap is a share of the floor area. Floor area is the 84-8 definition: it counts basements that are a story, attics with 8 ft headroom, porches more than 50% enclosed and accessory buildings (not parking space). A tax record's living area may be smaller than this.

max_share_of_house_and_unit.note: 'Shall not exceed 35% of the combined floor area of the principal dwelling plus the in-law suite.' For a suite inside the house the house floor area already includes it. Floor area as defined in 84-8 (basements that are a story, attics with 8 ft headroom, porches over 50% enclosed, accessory buildings).

max_height_ft.note: Only an existing accessory structure may be used. No accessory height rule for garages was found. Sheds are capped at 12 ft (84-57.21).

district_yards_bind_accessory.note: A private garage is an accessory structure 'in conformance with all area and bulk regulations of the zoning district involved'.

internal_uses_district_height.note: Three stories, not to exceed 30 ft.

owner_occupancy.note: No owner-occupancy rule. The suite is for a relative of the residents of the house.

occupancy.value: A relative of the residents of the house, and that relative's spouse. 84-8 relatives, by blood, marriage, adoption or formal foster relationship: brother, sister, parent, child, grandparent, great-grandparent, grandchild, great-grandchild, uncle, aunt, niece, nephew, sister-in-law, brother-in-law or parent-in-law. At most two occupants.

max_adus.note: The definition speaks of a single suite with the principal dwelling unit.

short_term_rental_banned.note: Renting to nonrelatives is barred. No separate short-term rental rule was searched.

spaces_required.note: 'Two spaces shall be required for each dwelling unit.' The suite is defined as a dwelling unit.

total_on_site.note: Two for the house and two for the suite.

principal_max_height_ft.note: Three stories, not to exceed 30 ft.

max_building_coverage.note: Lot coverage 25%. Green area at least 75%.

min_lot_sqft.note: With public sewer and public water. 22,000 with one of them, 30,000 with neither.

principal_max_height_ft.note: Three stories, not to exceed 30 ft.

max_building_coverage.note: Lot coverage 25%. Green area at least 50%.

value.when: Public sewer or public water only
Public sewer or public water only

min_lot_sqft.note: Single-family detached with public sewer and public water. 22,000 with one of them, 30,000 with neither.

principal_max_height_ft.note: Three stories, not to exceed 30 ft.

max_building_coverage.note: Lot coverage 25%. Green area at least 20%.
